RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a plea for arms
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: An envoy of a house at war asks the lord for weapons.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.arrivalText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} has ridden in from {FACTION} with a war behind {PETITIONER_objective}. Their house is fighting and losing, and they have come to ask the lord for weapons.\n\nHold court within {DAYS} days or they will look for them elsewhere, and remember where they were not found.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} speaks for {FACTION}, who are at war and short of steel. They ask for {SILVER} weapons, any weapons, and are not in a position to be particular about it. Arming a house is not a small thing: whatever they do with them afterwards is done with the lord's blades.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Arm them. Give the {SILVER} weapons
li.pastLabel: {SILVER} weapons given to a house at war

li.label: Refuse. Their war is not the lord's
Sell them the steel, at a war price
li.pastLabel: arms sold to a house at war

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a plea for provisions
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: An envoy of a hungry house asks the lord for food.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.arrivalText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} has come from {FACTION} on an empty stomach. Their house is hungry and they are asking the lord for food, which is not a thing a house asks lightly.\n\nHold court within {DAYS} days or they will go home and say the lord did not care to listen.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} speaks for {FACTION}, and speaks carefully, because asking for food is admitting you have none. They need {SILVER} units of it. A house remembers who fed it, and remembers rather longer who did not.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Give them the {SILVER} food they need
Refuse. The colony feeds its own first
Sell it to them, at a hungry man's price
li.pastLabel: food sold to a hungry house
